'''Morts Werl''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Fair-skinned with [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and a mustache, Werl joined the Alliance<ref name="anh" /> by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. In that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> Werl was present in the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]], the Alliance's main headquarters on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], and attended a briefing held by Alliance [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]], who discussed the Alliance's plans to attack the Imperial [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]].<ref name="anh" />

The Alliance's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] destroyed the DS-1 Orbital Battle Station in the subsequent [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. After the battle, a [[Royal Award Ceremony/Legends|ceremony]] was held in the Great Temple's [[Grand Audience Chamber]].<ref name="anh" /> Werl, who attained the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] by then,<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|133|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Celebrating a Rebel Victory!}}</ref> was present at the ceremony, during which the [[Medal of Bravery/Legends|Medal of Bravery]] was awarded to two of the victorious Rebel fighters: [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. Werl [[Clothing/Legends|wore]] a dark green [[Alliance military uniform/Legends|uniform]] with a lighter green [[Hat/Legends|cap]].<ref name="anh" />

==Behind the scenes==
Morts Werl first appeared in [[1977]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. The character went unnamed<ref name="anh" /> until [[May 1]], [[2012]],<ref name="Titan">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/133|text=Star Wars Insider #133}}</ref> as part of the "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery]]" feature of [[Star Wars Insider 133|''Star Wars Insider'' 133]].<ref name="Insider" />
